rules: This index points to evidence and records Cowork's review of it. It never sets canonical results; Work records those in tracking/acceptance.json.
Machine-produced artifacts stay unchanged at their artifact_paths; Cowork commentary lives only in review fields.
Null or an empty list means the fact is not available. Never fill it from expectation.
Record observed_result values: PASS, FAIL, ERROR, SKIPPED, RUNNING, copied from the artifact. A FAIL or ERROR is a result, not a readiness signal.
Record review_status values: REPORTED_NOT_INSPECTED, INSPECTED, INSPECTED_WITH_FINDINGS.
run_role distinguishes NORMAL runs from EXPECTED_DETECTION (a deliberately broken test-only fixture that must be detected) and HEALTHY_RERUN; an expected detection is never converted to PASS.
Evidence exists, evidence inspected, observed PASS and Work acceptance are four different facts.
Document-tool test fixtures never appear in this file.
r4 qualification rules are shared by generation and validation in evidence_rules.py; no commit-only equivalence.
VERIFIED_LOCAL means referenced bytes and report fields were checked now; HISTORICAL_UNAVAILABLE and REPORTED_NOT_INSPECTED never qualify.
T24 retains deliberate-fault FAIL between independently supported healthy controls. A later relevant failure/unreviewed run blocks older PASS selection.
Rehearsal indexed/started/aborted/completed/qualifying counters are distinct; two qualifying runs are required under the existing T30 criteria.

record_schema.raw_report_rules: Record/task/producer/handoff identity and full candidate/result identity must match. All child artifact_paths named by the raw report must be indexed and hash verified. Enclosing test ID and globally unique record IDs are required for candidate counts and claims.
